description: Production-ready admin dashboard template: React 19, TanStack Router (file-based routing), Base UI, Tailwind CSS v4, Vite. Includes auth, themes, multi-tabs, mock/live data layer, and AI-coding context (AGENTS.md).
rules: Use pnpm as the package manager; the dev server runs at http://localhost:5180
Routes are file-based: create files under src/routes and keep the createFileRoute path string strictly matching the file location
src/routeTree.gen.ts is auto-generated by the Vite plugin - never edit it by hand; run pnpm build if route types are stale
Adding a page requires a three-place sync: route file, src/app.config.ts (NavIcon type + NAV_GROUPS), src/components/layout/sidebar.tsx (ICONS map)
Reuse existing components from src/components (DemoBlock, PageHeader, Button, AppSelect, Badge, StatusBadge, FilterBar) instead of writing new ones
Use design token class names (text-ink, text-muted, border-line, bg-canvas, bg-surface, bg-brand-600) - never hard-code colors
Example pages must be self-contained with mock data from src/mocks - never issue real API requests in demo pages
Do not create ad-hoc directories (utils2, helpers, common); new files go into the established structure listed in guardai.yml allowed_dirs
